services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Our Private Events volunteers are a part of our Garden Guides team. They complete training alongside our docents and tour guides. Main Locations: Orangerie, Fragrance Garden, Rose Garden, Rose House, and Amphitheatre The Garden provides a beautiful backdrop for weddings, corporate events, memorials, private amphitheater gatherings, and more. Volunteers with the Special Events team assist in greeting and directing event guests, vendors, clients, and help redirect general public away from the private space. Most commonly, volunteers are a vital part of the evening for events taking place in our Orangerie, Fragrance Garden, Rose Garden, Rose House and Amphitheatre. Need to know: Special events

services.name: Garden Guides & Docents
services.desc: The Red Butte Garden School Programs team brings botany-based, informal, science education to tens of thousands of K-12 Utah students every year! We have the awesome job of planting seeds of curiosity, scientific literacy, and an appreciation of plants and nature and would love your help. Field Trips run in April, May, September, and October every year throughout the Garden. There are various options for different types and levels of involvement. Our Botany Bin & Box and Garden on the Grow programs bring the Garden, plant materials, scientific tools, and engaging lessons to students throughout the state of Utah. services.name: Summer Camp Volunteers
services.desc: Are you a plant or nature lover? Do you enjoy teaching elementary-aged children? Are you interested in sharing your love of the natural world with others? Red Butte Garden is looking for individuals interested in helping our Summer Camp Educators teach children ages 5-12 about plants, animals, and the wonders of the natural world through STEAM (science, technology, engineering, art, and math) investigations. Our weeklong camps take place throughout the Garden and run from early June through July. There are morning (9AM-Noon) sessions available. services.name: Garden Tours
services.desc: Lead tours and educate guests about Red Butte Garden. Opportunities include: Docent positions, Tour Guides (tram and walking), and Private Events. Share your love and knowledge of plants and Red Butte Garden with others by leading private and public tours (walking and/or driving a tram), answering guests' questions, hosting programs, or acting as an ambassador for the Garden throughout the community. Docents are stationed in the Four Seasons garden courtyard and other areas of the Garden to welcome guests, answer questions, and direct people through the Garden.
